hypotheses.name: Consensus-tier concentration of convexity/detour geometry lift
hypotheses.method: On seed42 across immune/lung/external_lung and source/target disjoint splits (layers 0/3/7/11), recomputed geodesic+diffusion baseline and convexity+detour extension, built consensus tiers from TRRUST + DoRothEA + GO co-annotation, and tested high-tier (>=2) vs low-tier (<=1) AUROC uplift gap with stratified tier-shuffle nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: -0.00801 (finite in 12/24 rows); 0/24 row-level p<0.05; 0/6 domain-split Fisher-significant
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this exact tier-gap formulation; if revisited, use prevalence-balanced tier bins and target-disjoint multiseed replication before interaction claims.

hypotheses.name: ID variance/skew mechanism for layerwise local-linearity AUROC
hypotheses.method: Across 3 domains x 3 seeds x 2 disjoint splits x 12 layers, computed TWO-NN and local participation-ratio moments (mean/var/skew), then compared mean-only vs mean+variance+skew regressions for edge local-linearity AUROC with per-seed split permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.35673 over 18 seed-split fits (positive in 18/18), but only 1/18 p<0.05 and 0/6 domain-split Fisher-significant
hypotheses.next_action: Run out-of-sample validation (leave-layer-out or split-held-out) and strengthen null calibration before promoting distributional ID mechanism claims.

hypotheses.name: Persistent-homology excess over feature-shuffle and geometry coupling
hypotheses.method: On seed42 across domains/splits/layers {0,3,7,11}, computed H1 persistence summaries with ripser on PCA residual manifolds, compared H1 total lifetime to feature-shuffle nulls, and measured row/domain coupling with convexity/detour geometry delta-AUROC.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.34579 across 24 rows, 5/6 domain-split mean z>0, global Spearman(h1_z, geometry_delta)=+0.3157, but 0/24 row-level p<0.05 and 0/6 domain-split Fisher-significant
hypotheses.next_action: Increase PH null strength (more permutations + subsample bootstrap) and test whether positive-z domains replicate across seeds before advancing.
